descripcion: A lab koala pet that works with you and measures your Claude Code usage: session and week limits, pace, equivalent cost, pomodoro, git and server.
cmd.configurar: set up the Claude Code monitor
cmd.agua: I drank a glass of water
cfg.idioma: The koala's language. auto = VS Code's language (Spanish if VS Code is in Spanish; otherwise English).
cfg.segundosParaDescansar: Seconds without activity in the editor or terminal before the koala stops working.
cfg.reaccionarAClaude: The koala works while Claude Code is in a turn (requires the monitor hooks).
cfg.avisarEnPorcentaje: Usage percentage (session or week) from which the koala notifies you.
cfg.pomodoro.minutosEnfoque: Minutes for each pomodoro experiment (focus block).
cfg.usoDesdeAnthropic: Check the real session and week % at api.anthropic.com with the Claude Code session stored on this machine (~/.claude/.credentials.json). The token is only sent to Anthropic.
cfg.aguaMlPorWh: Milliliters of water per Wh for the estimated footprint (cooling + power generation). References: ~0.5 efficient data center; ~2 commonly cited average; up to 12 in dry places.
cfg.costoPlanMensualUSD: What you pay per month for your Claude plan (USD), to compare it with the equivalent API cost. 0 = do not compare.
cfg.avisarCuandoClaudeEspera: Notification when Claude Code is waiting for your permission or an answer (besides the koala's raised hand).
cfg.avisarTurnoLargoSegundos: If a Claude turn lasts at least this many seconds, the koala tells you when it ends (notification only if VS Code isn't focused). 0 = never.
cfg.reaccionarAComandos: React when tests, builds, migrations or commands of 15 s or more finish in the terminal (requires VS Code's shell integration).
cfg.temporada.1: Day of the Dead (Oct 28–Nov 2): catrina and altar
cfg.temporada.2: Christmas (Dec 1–Jan 6): tree, and piñata during the posadas
cfg.minutosParaTreparse: Minutes of continuous activity (without a 10-minute break) before the koala climbs its eucalyptus to sleep; it comes down when you rest. 0 = never.
cfg.minutosParaSiesta: Minutes without activity (editor, terminal or Claude) before the koala falls asleep on the laptop. 0 = never.
cfg.cumpleanos: Your birthday as DD/MM (e.g. 29/03): that day the koala has a cake and a party hat.
cfg.clima.ciudad: City for the weather in the lab window. Better use the command «Science Koala: choose weather city» (it lets you pick between cities with the same name). Empty = no weather. Uses Open-Meteo (free, no account; needs internet). The koala does not detect your location on its own.
cfg.metaAgua: Glasses of water per day (💧 button in the Pet tab).
cfg.minutosPausaActiva: Minutes of continuous activity before the koala invites you to stretch. 0 = never.
cfg.visitantes: Every now and then a panda, an axolotl or an opossum drops by to say hi.
cfg.sonidos: Short sounds when Claude or a pomodoro finishes, when celebrating a commit and when unlocking an achievement.
cfg.servicios: Services the koala checks every minute (responding = green). Example: { "nombre": "Django", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:8000/" }.
cfg.barraDeEstado: Show Claude Code usage in VS Code's status bar.
